lessons.title: Sentence skills
lessons.subtitle: 先补句子骨架，再修五类常见错误
lessons.source: Sentence skills.pdf，PDF 1–32页；1. Sentence skills answer key.pdf，PDF 1–11页（与另一同名答案内容重复）。

rules.title: 独立从句与从属从句
rules.explanation: 独立从句有主语、限定动词并能独立表达完整意思。从属连词 because/although/when 等会使句子不能独立；要接主句。短语中有 -ing 不等于有谓语。
rules.example: 原创示例：Because the experiment failed, we revised the method.
rules.before: Because the experiment failed.
rules.after: Because the experiment failed, we revised the method.

rules.title: 四种句型
rules.explanation: simple：一个独立从句，可有并列主语/谓语；compound：至少两个独立从句；complex：一个独立从句加至少一个从属从句；compound-complex：至少两个独立从句加至少一个从属从句。按从句结构判断，不按长短判断。
rules.example: 原创示例：Although the task was difficult, we persisted, and we finished it.

rules.title: 并列句三种合法连接
rules.explanation: 独立句 + 逗号 + FANBOYS（for/and/nor/but/or/yet/so）；独立句 + 分号 + however/therefore 等 + 逗号；或语意密切的两句用分号。however 本身不能替代连词。nor 连接否定并列分句时常需倒装。
rules.example: 原创示例：The sample was small; therefore, the result requires caution.
rules.before: The sample was small, however, the effect was clear.
rules.after: The sample was small; however, the effect was clear.

rules.title: 主从句与信息重点
rules.explanation: 把主要信息放主句，把原因/条件/让步放从句。前置状语从句后通常用逗号。名词从句和定语从句需要与所属成分相连。避免 because...so 和 although...but 双重连接。
rules.example: 原创示例：Although tuition is high, many students attend college.
rules.before: Although tuition is high, but many students attend college.
rules.after: Although tuition is high, many students attend college.

rules.title: 平行结构
rules.explanation: and/or 及 both...and、either...or、neither...nor、not only...but also 两侧结构要对应：名词对名词、动名词对动名词、从句对从句。比较结构也需要平行。
rules.example: 原创示例：The course develops reading, writing, and critical thinking.
rules.before: The course develops reading, writing, and to think critically.
rules.after: The course develops reading, writing, and critical thinking.

rules.title: Fragment、run-on 与 comma splice
rules.explanation: fragment 缺完整句骨架；run-on 把独立句直接粘连；comma splice 仅用逗号连接独立句。可补主句、加句号/分号、加并列连词或改为主从结构。
rules.example: 原创示例：The data were incomplete, so we collected more.
rules.before: The data were incomplete we collected more.
rules.after: The data were incomplete, so we collected more.

rules.title: Choppy 与 stringy
rules.explanation: choppy 是连续短句过碎，用逻辑连接合并；stringy 是 and/so 串联过长，先分组再拆句。不是句子越长越学术，关键是信息关系明确。
rules.example: 原创示例：We reviewed the evidence before choosing a method.
rules.before: We reviewed the evidence, and we chose a method, and we ran a test, and we wrote a report.
rules.after: After reviewing the evidence, we chose a method. We then ran a test and wrote a report.

exercises.prompt: 改错：Because the library was closed. We studied at home.
exercises.answer: Because the library was closed, we studied at home.
exercises.explanation: 合并从属从句与主句，消除 fragment。

exercises.prompt: 改错：The results were promising, however, the sample was small.
exercises.answer: The results were promising; however, the sample was small.
exercises.explanation: however 是连接副词，前面应句号或分号。

exercises.prompt: 改错：Students need to read carefully, taking notes, and to review regularly.
exercises.answer: Students need to read carefully, take notes, and review regularly.
exercises.explanation: 并列谓语都用动词原形，承接 need to。

exercises.prompt: 用 although 合并：The method is simple. It is effective.
exercises.answer: Although the method is simple, it is effective.
exercises.explanation: 让步从句前置后加逗号。

exercises.prompt: 用 so 合并：The recording was unclear. We listened again.
exercises.answer: The recording was unclear, so we listened again.
exercises.explanation: 两个独立从句用逗号加并列连词。

exercises.prompt: 改错：The paper discusses both the causes and how the problem can be solved.
exercises.answer: The paper discusses both the causes and the solutions.
exercises.explanation: both...and 两侧统一为名词短语。

exercises.prompt: 改错：The students completed the task they checked their answers.
exercises.answer: The students completed the task; they checked their answers.
exercises.explanation: 也可用句号或 and 修复 run-on。

exercises.prompt: 用 nor 续写：The report does not explain the cause, ...（也没有提出解决办法）
exercises.answer: The report does not explain the cause, nor does it propose a solution.
exercises.explanation: nor 后倒装，does 后动词原形。

exercises.prompt: 判断句型：Although it was late, we continued working, and we finished the draft.
exercises.answer: compound-complex sentence（并列复合句）
exercises.explanation: 一个从属从句、两个独立从句。

exercises.prompt: 合并碎句：The course is useful. It improves reading. It develops writing.
exercises.answer: The course is useful because it improves reading and develops writing.
exercises.explanation: 用原因从句和并列谓语整合。

exercises.prompt: 拆分串句：I studied all morning, and I attended class all afternoon, and I revised at night, so I was tired.
exercises.answer: I studied all morning and attended class all afternoon. Since I also revised at night, I was tired.
exercises.explanation: 保留时间顺序与原因，减少连续 and。

exercises.prompt: 改错：Although the question was difficult, but she answered it correctly.
exercises.answer: Although the question was difficult, she answered it correctly.
exercises.explanation: although 不与 but 重复连接同一关系。

sourceExamples.text: The sun rose.
sourceExamples.note: 独立从句的最简骨架。

sourceExamples.text: Learning a new language is like learning to swim, for it takes a lot of practice.
sourceExamples.note: 并列连词 for 引出解释。

lessons.title: paragraph structure
lessons.subtitle: 一个段落，一个中心
lessons.source: paragraph structure.pdf，PDF 1–16页；paragraph strurcture  answer key.pdf，PDF 1–3页。

rules.title: 段落三部分
rules.explanation: topic sentence 提出主题与控制思想；supporting sentences 解释和证明；concluding sentence 回收主旨。独立段落通常需要结句，长文中的每个主体段不一定都要单独结句。
rules.example: 原创示例：Regular review improves vocabulary retention. Short daily sessions help learners revisit difficult words.

rules.title: Topic + controlling idea
rules.explanation: 主题回答“写什么”；控制思想回答“从哪个具体角度写”。主题句必须完整，范围适中；不能只是标题、极泛的事实或孤立细节。
rules.example: 原创示例：Studying with a partner offers two practical benefits.
rules.before: Education is important.
rules.after: Peer study improves learning by encouraging explanation and regular review.

rules.title: 支撑必须具体
rules.explanation: 用解释、例子、事实、数据发展控制思想。每句都要回答“为什么/如何/例如”；不要把主旨换词反复说。练习中的数字若自拟，必须标明，不冒充调查。
rules.example: 原创示例：For example, learners can explain difficult grammar rules to each other.
rules.before: Study groups are good. They are very helpful.
rules.after: Study groups help members identify errors by comparing their answers.

rules.title: 识别主题句与段落顺序
rules.explanation: 主题句常在开头，也可能居中或结尾。选句题要看整段覆盖范围：过宽无法统摄，过窄只覆盖一个例子。
rules.example: 原创示例：A list of two study benefits needs a topic sentence that covers both.

rules.title: 结句收束、不加新论点
rules.explanation: 结句可换说主题句或总结主要支撑。不能突然引入尚未讨论的新好处。In conclusion 等不是每段必需，也不宜机械重复。
rules.example: 原创示例：These benefits make peer study a useful part of exam preparation.
rules.before: In conclusion, peer study also improves physical health.
rules.after: Together, shared explanations and regular practice make peer study effective.

exercises.prompt: 指出 topic 和 controlling idea：Online courses offer flexibility for working students.
exercises.answer: topic: Online courses；controlling idea: offer flexibility for working students
exercises.explanation: 主题与讨论角度分开。

exercises.prompt: 把标题改成主题句：The advantages of regular review
exercises.answer: Regular review helps learners remember and use new vocabulary.
exercises.explanation: 补主语谓语并限定角度。

exercises.prompt: 选择合适主题句：A. Education matters. B. Daily listening practice improves recognition of common phrases. C. I listened for ten minutes yesterday.
exercises.answer: B
exercises.explanation: A太泛，C是细节。

exercises.prompt: 为“Libraries provide a good environment for study.”写一个具体支撑句。
exercises.answer: Quiet reading areas allow students to concentrate without frequent interruptions.
exercises.explanation: 须说明环境如何支持学习，答案不唯一。

exercises.prompt: 删去离题句：Regular review improves memory. It brings difficult words back to attention. My classroom has blue walls. It also reveals what needs more practice.
exercises.answer: My classroom has blue walls.
exercises.explanation: 颜色不支撑复习的作用。

exercises.prompt: 为“Peer study helps students compare answers and explain difficult ideas.”写结句。
exercises.answer: For these reasons, studying with peers can make review more effective.
exercises.explanation: 回收两项好处，不添加新主张。

exercises.prompt: 改进过泛主题句：Technology changes everything.
exercises.answer: Online learning tools make exam preparation more flexible.
exercises.explanation: 限定技术类型与使用场景。

exercises.prompt: 改进过细主题句：I reviewed twelve words at eight yesterday.
exercises.answer: Short daily vocabulary sessions help me maintain a regular review habit.
exercises.explanation: 用控制思想覆盖可发展的内容。

exercises.prompt: 排序：A. For example, it lets students pause a recording. B. Digital audio supports careful listening. C. This control helps them notice difficult phrases.
exercises.answer: B → A → C
exercises.explanation: 先主旨，再例子，最后解释作用。

exercises.prompt: 判断：一个学术段落必须刚好五句话。
exercises.answer: 错误。长度取决于主旨是否充分展开。
exercises.explanation: 教材强调发展主旨，句数不是硬标准。

exercises.prompt: 判断：长文的每个主体段都必须以 In conclusion 开始结句。
exercises.answer: 错误。主体段可直接转入下段，结句是否需要由内容决定。
exercises.explanation: 避免把独立段落模板机械套用。

exercises.prompt: 扩写：Regular reading supports vocabulary learning.（再写两句支撑）
exercises.answer: Readers meet familiar words in new contexts. These repeated encounters help them understand how the words are used.
exercises.explanation: 解释机制而非简单重复主旨。

sourceExamples.text: Gold, a precious metal, is prized for two important characteristics.
sourceExamples.note: 以Gold为主题，以two important characteristics限定讨论范围。

sourceExamples.text: In conclusion, gold is treasured not only for its beauty but also for its utility.
sourceExamples.note: 总结美观与用途，未引入第三项新内容。

lessons.title: unity and coherence
lessons.subtitle: 删离题句，把句与句连起来
lessons.source: unity and coherence.pdf，PDF 1–21页；unity and coherence answer key.pdf，PDF 1–4页。
lessons.markdownPath: materials/02_写作精华/unity and coherence精华.md

rules.title: Unity：只讨论一个中心
rules.explanation: 删去与控制思想无关的句子；一段如果出现两个大主题，拆段。相关词出现不等于逻辑相关。
rules.example: 原创示例：讨论听力复习方法时，“耳机价格上涨”通常需要删去。

rules.title: 四条连贯路径
rules.explanation: 重复关键词；使用一致且指代清楚的代词；选择准确连接信号；按逻辑顺序组织。连贯不等于堆连接词。
rules.example: 原创示例：Daily review is useful. This habit keeps difficult phrases active in memory.

rules.title: 关键词与代词
rules.explanation: 适量重复关键名词有助清晰；不要为避免重复随意换成含义不同的词。人称、单复数保持一致；it/they/this 必须能找到明确先行词。
rules.example: 原创示例：Students should review their notes before they begin the task.
rules.before: Students should review your notes before he begins.
rules.after: Students should review their notes before they begin.

rules.title: 连接词先语义，后语法
rules.explanation: 递进 furthermore；转折 however；因果 therefore/as a result；举例 for example；比较 similarly/in contrast。because + 从句，because of + 名词短语；although + 从句，despite + 名词/动名词。
rules.example: 原创示例：Despite the high cost, the course remained popular.
rules.before: Despite the course was expensive, it remained popular.
rules.after: Although the course was expensive, it remained popular.

rules.title: 标点与位置
rules.explanation: 连接副词放两独立句之间时用分号/句号；并列连词用逗号连接；前置从属从句后通常加逗号。连接词不能代替句子结构。
rules.example: 原创示例：The task was difficult; nevertheless, they completed it.

rules.title: 逻辑顺序与节制
rules.explanation: 按时间、分类分点、比较对照组织；先明确结构再加连接信号。过多 First/Next/Then 不会自动改善逻辑，显然的步骤可省略。
rules.example: 原创示例：Read the passage, identify its main points, and then write a summary.

exercises.prompt: 填入合适连接词：The recording was fast. ___, I understood its main point.
exercises.answer: However / Nevertheless
exercises.explanation: 语义是让步转折。

exercises.prompt: 填入合适连接词：The room was noisy. ___, I moved to the library.
exercises.answer: Therefore / As a result
exercises.explanation: 第二句是结果。

exercises.prompt: 改错：Despite the exam was difficult, she remained calm.
exercises.answer: Although the exam was difficult, she remained calm.
exercises.explanation: 也可改 Despite the difficulty of the exam。

exercises.prompt: 改错：Because of the library closed early, we left.
exercises.answer: Because the library closed early, we left.
exercises.explanation: because 后可接完整从句。

exercises.prompt: 改错：Students need practice if you want to improve their writing.
exercises.answer: Students need practice if they want to improve their writing.
exercises.explanation: 保持第三人称复数一致。

exercises.prompt: 澄清指代：The tutor gave the student a book, but she did not read it.（未读者是学生）
exercises.answer: The tutor gave the student a book, but the student did not read it.
exercises.explanation: 重复名词以消除歧义。

exercises.prompt: 删除离题句：Audio practice builds phrase recognition. Short clips can be replayed. My phone case is green. Repetition helps learners notice word boundaries.
exercises.answer: My phone case is green.
exercises.explanation: 段落中心是音频练习的作用。

exercises.prompt: 改错：The task was demanding, therefore, we planned it carefully.
exercises.answer: The task was demanding; therefore, we planned it carefully.
exercises.explanation: 修复comma splice。

exercises.prompt: 识别顺序：先列原因一，再列原因二，最后列原因三。
exercises.answer: logical division of ideas（分点/分类顺序）
exercises.explanation: 不是时间顺序。

exercises.prompt: 排序：A. Finally, check the source again. B. First, read for meaning. C. Then, write from notes.
exercises.answer: B → C → A
exercises.explanation: 改写任务的时间/步骤顺序。

exercises.prompt: 减少冗余：First, open the file. Next, then, read the first paragraph. Finally, in conclusion, take notes.
exercises.answer: Open the file and read the first paragraph. Then take notes.
exercises.explanation: 同义连接信号重复应删去。

exercises.prompt: 把两个句子连贯地接起来：Daily practice builds confidence. Confidence helps students remain calm during the test.
exercises.answer: Daily practice builds confidence. This confidence helps students remain calm during the test.
exercises.explanation: 关键词重复加指示词建立承接；原句本身也可接受。

questionTypes: 补重复关键词和近义替换
识别、选择并标点连接词
辨认时间、分点、比较顺序

sourceExamples.text: There are four ways to achieve coherence:
sourceExamples.note: 随后列出关键词、代词、连接信号、逻辑顺序四项。

sourceExamples.text: Although the company’s sales increased last year, its net profit declined.
sourceExamples.note: 前置让步从句后用逗号。

lessons.title: supporting details
lessons.subtitle: 用事实、引文和数据支撑观点
lessons.source: supporting details.pdf，PDF 1–16页；supporting details answer key.pdf，PDF 1–3页。

rules.title: 观点需要具体依据
rules.explanation: fact 可查证，opinion 是判断；事实也需核对出处与语境。论点→证据→解释，避免只有引文没有自己的分析。教材旧数据是语言练习材料，不当作今天的统计。
rules.example: 原创示例：A quiet room supports concentration because it reduces interruptions.

rules.title: 直接引语
rules.explanation: 保留原词，用引号并标来源。报告语在前通常接逗号；引号内句首大写。中间插入报告语时，原句第二部分不因此强制大写。
rules.example: 原创示例：The tutor said, "Review your notes carefully."
rules.before: The tutor said "review your notes carefully".
rules.after: The tutor said, "Review your notes carefully."

rules.title: 间接引语
rules.explanation: 不加引号，按语境调整代词、时间词和时态。过去式报告动词常触发时态后移；仍成立的事实可保留现在时，不能机械后移。陈述语序保留。
rules.example: 原创示例：The tutor said that the task was useful.
rules.before: The tutor said that "the task was useful."
rules.after: The tutor said that the task was useful.

rules.title: 报告动词与解释
rules.explanation: according to、report、state、argue、suggest 反映来源立场；不要把 suggest 升格为 prove。引文后解释它如何支持主旨。
rules.example: 原创示例：The author argues that regular review is valuable. This view supports a daily practice plan.

rules.title: 统计信息与图表
rules.explanation: 先交代来源和主趋势，再选择关键对比。检查单位、年份、分母、百分比与百分点；区分观察值与预测值。不得虚构数据填补论据。
rules.example: 原创练习数据：A rate rising from 20% to 30% increases by 10 percentage points, or 50% relative to the initial rate.

rules.title: 来源可追溯
rules.explanation: 直接引语、转述、摘要、非公共知识的数据均需要来源。文内引用与文末条目对应；教材含较旧引用格式，考试按教师指定版本。
rules.example: 原创示例：According to the provided chart, participation increased between the two years.

exercises.prompt: 判断：Regular review is the best study method. 属于可直接查证的事实还是观点？
exercises.answer: 观点
exercises.explanation: best 是评价，需要比较标准和证据。

exercises.prompt: 给引语加标点：The tutor said review the final paragraph carefully
exercises.answer: The tutor said, "Review the final paragraph carefully."
exercises.explanation: 报告语后逗号、句首大写、引号。

exercises.prompt: 改成间接引语，报告时间在过去：Lina said, "I am tired."
exercises.answer: Lina said that she was tired.
exercises.explanation: I随说话人改为she，am通常后移为was。

exercises.prompt: 改成间接引语：The student said, "I have completed the task."
exercises.answer: The student said that they had completed the task.
exercises.explanation: 也可按已知性别用he/she；现在完成时通常后移。

exercises.prompt: 改错：According to the author argues that review is useful.
exercises.answer: According to the author, review is useful.
exercises.explanation: 或 The author argues that review is useful。两个报告结构不要叠加。

exercises.prompt: 给观点补一种具体证据：Short recordings are useful for repeated listening.
exercises.answer: For example, a learner can replay the same short section until the phrase boundaries become clear.
exercises.explanation: 用可理解的实例解释作用，不虚构研究。

exercises.prompt: 练习数据：比例从40%升到50%，增加多少个百分点？
exercises.answer: 10 percentage points
exercises.explanation: 相对增幅为25%，不是10%。

exercises.prompt: 练习数据：某图表的2020年值为实测，2030年值为预测。写比较句。
exercises.answer: The chart records the 2020 value and projects a higher value for 2030.
exercises.explanation: 须用projects/expected等区分预测；仅在图中较高时成立。

exercises.prompt: 判断：把引文改成自己的话后就不需要引用。
exercises.answer: 错误。改写仍使用来源的思想，需要标注来源。
exercises.explanation: 文字改写不改变思想归属。

exercises.prompt: 修正过度断言：The author suggests an association. Therefore, the study proves causation.
exercises.answer: The author suggests an association; this does not by itself establish causation.
exercises.explanation: 保留原证据力度。

exercises.prompt: 为引文添加解释：“Daily practice provides repeated exposure.”（练习自拟引文）
exercises.answer: This repeated exposure may help learners recognize familiar phrases more quickly.
exercises.explanation: 解释证据和学习效果的联系；不冒充真实文献。

exercises.prompt: 检查数据句：The number rose significantly. 缺少哪些信息？
exercises.answer: 缺少起止值、时间、单位与来源；significantly若指统计显著还需检验依据。
exercises.explanation: 补具体信息才可验证，不能擅自编数字。

sourceExamples.text: Like quotations, statistics are good supporting details.
sourceExamples.note: 同页明确统计数据也要交代来源。

sourceExamples.text: You must also cite the source of statistical data.
sourceExamples.page: 教材 PDF 13页（印刷页51；原句中段）
sourceExamples.note: 数据不能脱离来源。

lessons.subtitle: 从段落扩展为有中心的文章

rules.title: 三段式功能，不是固定三段
rules.explanation: 引言提出背景和thesis；主体每段一项分论点；结论重述中心、概括主要理由并收束。150–200词训练可用四段，但字数与段数是训练安排，不是已确认考试要求。
rules.example: 原创示例：Introduction → benefit 1 → benefit 2 → conclusion.

rules.title: 引言从一般到具体
rules.explanation: funnel introduction 先背景、再具体问题、最后thesis；也可用相关事例吸引注意。不能开头堆泛泛套话。
rules.example: 原创示例：Many students use digital resources. For exam preparation, short audio clips offer flexible and focused practice.

rules.title: Thesis 可发展、范围可控
rules.explanation: 避免只是事实、空泛评价或“This essay will discuss...”式纯宣布；明确中心判断和可选分点。列举分点须平行，且与主体段顺序一致。
rules.example: 原创示例：Daily review improves preparation by strengthening recall and revealing weaknesses.
rules.before: This essay is about learning.
rules.after: Daily review improves preparation by strengthening recall and revealing weaknesses.

rules.title: Logical division 与提纲
rules.explanation: 将主题拆成互不重复、共同支撑thesis的分点。提纲各层级对齐：I/II/III 为大部分；A/B 为主体段；1/2 为支撑细节。
rules.example: 原创示例：Body A: stronger recall → repeated exposure；Body B: clearer priorities → identify errors.

rules.title: 段间衔接
rules.explanation: 新段主题句可承接上段词汇或总结上段后转入下一点。只添加Moreover而没有主题关联，仍会松散。
rules.example: 原创示例：In addition to improving recall, regular review reveals persistent errors.

rules.title: 结论三任务
rules.explanation: 标记收尾；重述thesis或概括分点；给与论证一致的最后评述。不能引入未经论证的新理由，也不逐字照抄引言。
rules.example: 原创示例：By improving recall and exposing weaknesses, daily review makes preparation more focused.

exercises.prompt: 改进thesis：This essay will discuss the Internet.
exercises.answer: The Internet supports academic study by widening access to information and enabling collaboration.
exercises.explanation: 具体主题、中心判断、平行分点。

exercises.prompt: 改进事实型thesis：Universities have libraries.
exercises.answer: University libraries support independent learning by providing reliable resources and quiet study spaces.
exercises.explanation: 事实改为可展开的中心判断。

exercises.prompt: 修正不平行分点：Good study habits require planning, to review, and that you rest.
exercises.answer: Good study habits require planning, reviewing, and resting.
exercises.explanation: 全部动名词。

exercises.prompt: 给thesis“Peer study improves understanding and motivation.”列两个主体段主题。
exercises.answer: 1. Explaining ideas to peers improves understanding. 2. A shared schedule strengthens motivation.
exercises.explanation: 每段一项，顺序与thesis对应。

exercises.prompt: 排序引言：A. Short listening sessions are especially useful for exam review. B. Digital media are common in education. C. Many students now use recordings to study independently.
exercises.answer: B → C → A
exercises.explanation: 一般背景逐渐收窄。

exercises.prompt: 为第二主体段写衔接句：第一段谈词汇记忆，第二段谈发现薄弱点。
exercises.answer: Besides strengthening vocabulary recall, regular review helps students identify weaknesses.
exercises.explanation: 承接旧点，引入新点。

exercises.prompt: 写结论重述：Daily practice improves accuracy and confidence.
exercises.answer: Consistent practice can make students both more accurate and more confident.
exercises.explanation: 保持原义，用不同结构。

exercises.prompt: 判断：结论中突然提出一个此前没有讨论的新研究结果。
exercises.answer: 通常不合适；应在主体论证后再在结论概括。
exercises.explanation: 结论不能新增无支撑论据。

exercises.prompt: 识别结构：先背景，接thesis，然后逐项讲三种原因。
exercises.answer: logical division of ideas（按分点展开）
exercises.explanation: 主体三段分别发展一种原因。

exercises.prompt: 将“阅读—讨论—写作”组织成简短提纲，主题是学术英语训练。
exercises.answer: I. Introduction: integrated practice; II. Reading for models; III. Discussion for understanding; IV. Writing for application; V. Conclusion.
exercises.explanation: 提纲层级、平行形式与逻辑即可；答案不唯一。

exercises.prompt: 为“Studying abroad involves academic and cultural adjustment.”补引言背景句。
exercises.answer: Students who enter a university in another country often encounter unfamiliar expectations.
exercises.explanation: 背景要通向thesis而非与之无关。

exercises.prompt: 检查thesis与主体一致性：thesis说两项好处，主体分别写好处、费用、食物。
exercises.answer: 重组为两项好处；费用与食物只有直接支撑这两项时才保留。
exercises.explanation: 全文统一性依赖各段服从thesis。

sourceExamples.text: An essay is a piece of writing several paragraphs long.
sourceExamples.note: 文章通过多个段落展开同一中心。

sourceExamples.text: A healthy lifestyle involves eating a nutritious diet, exercising regularly, and getting enough sleep at night.
sourceExamples.note: thesis中的三个分点均为动名词短语。

lessons.title: cause and effect essays
lessons.subtitle: 分清因果方向，再选择展开方式
lessons.source: cause and effect essays.pdf，PDF 1–22页；cause and effect essays answer keys.pdf，PDF 1–3页，限Chapter 4内容，答案页含相邻章节片段。

rules.title: Cause与effect
rules.explanation: cause回答为什么发生，effect回答导致什么。先确定中心结果或中心原因，再列支撑；不能只按时间先后就断定因果。
rules.example: 原创示例：A lack of sleep may reduce concentration.
rules.before: After the course began, scores rose, so the course must have caused the increase.
rules.after: Scores rose after the course began, but other explanations should also be considered.

rules.title: Chain organization
rules.explanation: 一个原因引出结果，这个结果成为下一环原因。适合真正逐环联系的因果链，每一环需解释，而不只是事件列表。
rules.example: 原创示例：Repeated crop failure → food shortage → migration.（结构练习，不额外证明史实）

rules.title: Block organization
rules.explanation: 各原因或结果没有直接先后依赖时，按块逐项分析。可以集中多个原因解释一个结果，也可由一个原因分析多个结果。
rules.example: 原创示例：Poor concentration may reflect noise, fatigue, and unclear instructions.

rules.title: 证据与限制语
rules.explanation: 解释机制并用资料、实例、统计或引文支撑；检查遗漏原因、反向因果、过度简化。证据有限时用may/might/contribute to，不把相关性写成必然。
rules.example: 原创示例：Noise may contribute to poor concentration.

rules.title: 因果信号语法
rules.explanation: because/since + 从句；because of/due to/owing to + 名词短语；result in + 结果，result from + 原因；lead to/contribute to 后接名词或动名词。therefore前需句号/分号。
rules.example: 原创示例：The delay resulted from bad weather.
rules.before: The delay resulted in bad weather.
rules.after: The delay resulted from bad weather.

rules.title: 平行结构与短语动词
rules.explanation: 教材同时训练并列项对称，及put up、depend on、bring about等短语动词的可分/不可分。可分动词带代词宾语时通常把代词置中间。
rules.example: 原创示例：The city needs to improve housing, reduce pollution, and expand transport.
rules.before: The change brought about it.
rules.after: The change brought it about.

rules.title: 引用与写作流程
rules.explanation: 先找原因/结果和可靠来源，再定chain/block，列提纲、起草、检查论据、修订和校对。引用之后要解释与因果主旨的关系。
rules.example: 原创示例：The report describes a shortage. This shortage may help explain the subsequent migration.

exercises.prompt: 填词：The delay resulted ___ a lack of staff.
exercises.answer: from
exercises.explanation: 后面是原因。

exercises.prompt: 填词：A lack of staff resulted ___ delays.
exercises.answer: in
exercises.explanation: 后面是结果。

exercises.prompt: 改错：Because of the roads were closed, deliveries stopped.
exercises.answer: Because the roads were closed, deliveries stopped.
exercises.explanation: 从句用because。

exercises.prompt: 选择结构：一次停电导致设备停止、数据丢失和服务中断；三项后果并列。
exercises.answer: block organization
exercises.explanation: 三项结果不要求互相构成因果链。

exercises.prompt: 选择结构：持续干旱→收成下降→粮价上升→家庭开支增加。
exercises.answer: chain organization
exercises.explanation: 上一结果成为下一环原因。

exercises.prompt: 改写避免强断言：Using this app will always improve every student’s score.
exercises.answer: Using this app may help some students improve their scores.
exercises.explanation: 移除always/every，按证据保留范围。

exercises.prompt: 修正平行结构：The policy aims to reduce costs, improving access, and support teachers.
exercises.answer: The policy aims to reduce costs, improve access, and support teachers.
exercises.explanation: 三个不定式谓语平行。

exercises.prompt: 解释问题：It rained before my test, so the rain caused my low score.
exercises.answer: 时间先后不足以证明因果，还需机制并排除其他解释。
exercises.explanation: 属于把顺序误当因果。

exercises.prompt: 用because合并：The room was noisy. I could not concentrate.
exercises.answer: I could not concentrate because the room was noisy.
exercises.explanation: 正确表达因果方向。

exercises.prompt: 用therefore合并：The bus was late. We missed the opening talk.
exercises.answer: The bus was late; therefore, we missed the opening talk.
exercises.explanation: 连接副词前用分号。

exercises.prompt: 改错：The reform brought about it.
exercises.answer: The reform brought it about.
exercises.explanation: it代词放在可分短语动词中间。

exercises.prompt: 写一句限定因果结论：数据只显示学习时间与成绩相关。
exercises.answer: Longer study time was associated with higher scores, but this relationship does not establish causation.
exercises.explanation: 不把关联升级为因果。

sourceExamples.text: A cause is a reason something happened or is happening, while an effect is the change that results from something happening.
sourceExamples.note: 因果的方向定义。

sourceExamples.text: A chain organization examines causes and effects that are directly linked sequentially.
sourceExamples.note: 链式须有直接递进关联。

lessons.title: argumentative essays
lessons.subtitle: 有立场，也要处理反对意见
lessons.source: argumentative essays.pdf，PDF 1–23页；argumentative essays answer key.pdf，PDF 1–2页，限Chapter 8，含相邻章节答案片段。

rules.title: 论证的组成
rules.explanation: 争议背景→明确立场→理由与证据→counterargument→rebuttal→结论。论证不是情绪化争吵，也不是只列正方理由。
rules.example: 原创示例：Although online classes offer flexibility, some tasks still benefit from face-to-face interaction.

rules.title: Block 与 point-by-point
rules.explanation: block：反方与反驳集中一组，己方论证集中另一组；point-by-point：每一重点下呈现反方、反驳和证据。两种都要让读者知道作者最终立场。
rules.example: 原创示例：Cost objection → response; quality objection → response.

rules.title: 框定争议与受众
rules.explanation: 引言交代双方争点和作者判断。考虑supportive/neutral/antagonistic读者；不同受众需要不同背景与证据，但不能歪曲对方观点。
rules.example: 原创示例：Some students question the cost of university, while others emphasize its long-term value.

rules.title: 让步与反驳
rules.explanation: 可以指出证据不充分、承认部分合理再说明局限，或权衡双方后坚持立场。避免稻草人，反驳针对理由而非攻击持论者。
rules.example: 原创示例：Admittedly, the course is expensive. However, its flexible schedule can reduce travel costs.

rules.title: 情态动词与短语情态
rules.explanation: should建议，must强要求，may/might可能，could可能/建议；后接动词原形。be able to/have to/ought to按各自结构，be/have随主语与时态变化。
rules.example: 原创示例：Students should evaluate evidence carefully.
rules.before: Students should to evaluate evidence.
rules.after: Students should evaluate evidence.

rules.title: 建议类虚拟语气
rules.explanation: suggest/recommend/require/insist等表示建议或要求时可用that + 主语 + 动词原形；否定为not + 原形，被动为be + 过去分词。注意suggest表示“表明”时不机械套虚拟。
rules.example: 原创示例：The committee recommends that the policy be revised.
rules.before: The committee recommends that the policy is revised.
rules.after: The committee recommends that the policy be revised.

rules.title: 报告动词和词性
rules.explanation: claim/argue/assert指提出主张；concede承认部分；challenge/refute质疑/反驳。词性变化要适配句子，如benefit/beneficial、significance/significant。
rules.example: 原创示例：Critics challenge the claim, but supporters provide additional evidence.

exercises.prompt: 改错：Students should to consider both sides.
exercises.answer: Students should consider both sides.
exercises.explanation: should后动词原形。

exercises.prompt: 改错：The tutor recommends that every student writes an outline.
exercises.answer: The tutor recommends that every student write an outline.
exercises.explanation: 建议类that从句用原形。

exercises.prompt: 补全：The committee requires that the proposal ___ revised.
exercises.answer: be
exercises.explanation: 虚拟语气被动be revised。

exercises.prompt: 改错：The teacher insists that the student not submits the unfinished draft.
exercises.answer: The teacher insists that the student not submit the unfinished draft.
exercises.explanation: 要求类虚拟否定not + 原形。

exercises.prompt: 改错：She have to support her argument with evidence.
exercises.answer: She has to support her argument with evidence.
exercises.explanation: phrasal modal随主语变化。

exercises.prompt: 区分：Some claim that online classes reduce interaction. However, well-designed discussion tasks can address this problem. 哪句为counterargument？
exercises.answer: 第一句是counterargument；第二句是rebuttal。
exercises.explanation: 识别对立观点与回应。

exercises.prompt: 选择结构：每个主体段先提一项质疑，再用证据回应该质疑。
exercises.answer: point-by-point organization
exercises.explanation: 逐点对照反驳。

exercises.prompt: 用让步写一句：同意电子书便携，但认为纸书仍有价值。
exercises.answer: Although e-books are convenient to carry, printed books can still be valuable for focused reading.
exercises.explanation: 承认合理点并保持立场，答案不唯一。

exercises.prompt: 修改人身攻击：Anyone who disagrees with this policy is stupid.
exercises.answer: Critics raise concerns about cost, but these concerns should be weighed against the expected benefits.
exercises.explanation: 回应论点，不评价对方人格。

exercises.prompt: 选择词形：The findings are of great ___ (significant/significance).
exercises.answer: significance
exercises.explanation: of great后接名词。

exercises.prompt: 写立场句：大学是否应保留面对面小组讨论？
exercises.answer: Universities should retain face-to-face discussion because it supports immediate feedback and active participation.
exercises.explanation: 明确立场加可发展的理由。

exercises.prompt: 判断：只给正方论据，从不提反方意见，也完全满足本章argumentative essay训练。
exercises.answer: 不满足本章重点；需要呈现并处理对立立场。
exercises.explanation: 教材明确要求counterargument与rebuttal。

sourceExamples.text: I suggest that computer simulations be used.
sourceExamples.page: 教材 PDF 9页（印刷页154，示例表格合并阅读）
sourceExamples.note: that后用be，不受主句时态或主语数影响。

sourceExamples.text: An argument, however, is not a fight.
sourceExamples.note: 本章强调证据论证。

lessons.title: paraphrase and summary
lessons.subtitle: 保留原义，真正重组表达
lessons.source: paraphrase and summary.pdf，PDF 1–15页；paraphrase and summary answer key.pdf，PDF 1–2页；zip中的同名教材内容重复。
lessons.markdownPath: materials/02_写作精华/paraphrase and summary精华.md

rules.title: Paraphrase与summary
rules.explanation: paraphrase以自己词汇和句式保留原段的主要信息与必要细节，长度通常相近；summary显著缩短，只保留主旨和主要支撑。两者均不能添加个人观点或改变原义。
rules.example: 原创示例：Original: Regular practice can improve recall. Paraphrase: Learners may remember more effectively through consistent practice.

rules.title: 两类常见问题
rules.explanation: 没有引用思想来源；虽有引用却只换少数词、保留原句结构。考试判断标签包括Too sim.、No cit.、Inc./Inacc.。
rules.example: 原创示例：may不能改成will，some不能改成all。

rules.title: 五步改写
rules.explanation: 反复读懂→记关键词而非整句→合上原文写→逐项对照范围、因果、否定、数字与语气→加文内引用。术语可保留，不强求每个词都找近义词。
rules.example: 原创示例：理解原因/结果关系后，再用result from代替because结构。

rules.title: 同义替换加句法重构
rules.explanation: 主动/被动转换；名词化/动词化；拆句/合句；从句与短语转换；改变信息起点。变化服务于准确，不为改写而扭曲重点。
rules.example: 原创示例：The researchers analyzed the data. → The data were analyzed by the researchers.

rules.title: 摘要取舍
rules.explanation: 保留研究/文章核心问题、主要发现或主张及必要限制；删去例子、重复、次要数字与修辞。依据题干要求决定是否保留作者名、字数与来源。
rules.example: 原创示例：A passage that gives three examples of review benefits can be summarized by the shared benefit.

rules.title: 作为论据使用
rules.explanation: 先写自己的主题句，再用来源的改写/摘要支撑，随后解释联系。不是把别人的摘要拼在一起替代自己的论证。
rules.example: 原创示例：Frequent review deserves a place in study plans. The supplied passage explains how repeated exposure supports recall. This supports short daily sessions.

exercises.prompt: 改写：Students can access the recordings at any time.
exercises.answer: The recordings are available to students whenever they need them.
exercises.explanation: 改变主语与句式，保留随时可访问的意思。

exercises.prompt: 改写：The high cost prevented some students from joining the course.
exercises.answer: Some students could not enroll in the course because it was too expensive.
exercises.explanation: 保留some与因果关系。

exercises.prompt: 改写：Daily review may improve vocabulary retention.
exercises.answer: Learners may retain vocabulary better if they review it every day.
exercises.explanation: 保留may，不升格为保证。

exercises.prompt: 判断错误：原文Some learners benefit from group work. 改写All learners learn best in groups.
exercises.answer: 不准确：some变all，并增加best。
exercises.explanation: 范围与比较力度被改变。

exercises.prompt: 判断错误：有引用，但只把important换成significant，其余逐字相同。
exercises.answer: Too similar（过度接近原文）。
exercises.explanation: 引用不能替代实质性改写，原词照引需引号。

exercises.prompt: 判断错误：准确改写某作者观点但没有标明来源。
exercises.answer: No citation（缺引用）。
exercises.explanation: 思想来源仍需标注。

exercises.prompt: 改成被动：The researchers collected the responses online.
exercises.answer: The responses were collected online by the researchers.
exercises.explanation: 保持过去时与动作对象。

exercises.prompt: 以名词短语改写：Because the population grew rapidly, housing became scarce.
exercises.answer: Rapid population growth contributed to a housing shortage.
exercises.explanation: 注意原文若明确单一因果，contributed to较谨慎；也可用led to。

exercises.prompt: 合并改写：The task was difficult. The students completed it successfully.
exercises.answer: Despite the difficulty of the task, the students completed it successfully.
exercises.explanation: 使用让步短语，保留成功完成。

exercises.prompt: 写一句摘要：Short recordings can be replayed easily. Learners can focus on difficult phrases. They can also compare their answers with the transcript.
exercises.answer: Short recordings support focused listening practice through replay and comparison with transcripts.
exercises.explanation: 删具体过程，保留共同主旨。

exercises.prompt: 摘要中可否加入“I strongly agree with the author”？
exercises.answer: 纯summary不应加入；若题目要求summary-response，应另列response部分。
exercises.explanation: 区分摘要与评价。

exercises.prompt: 改写练习并引用：给定来源Li，练习页码12；原句Regular practice helps students identify recurring errors.
exercises.answer: Students can notice repeated mistakes through consistent practice (Li 12).

rules.title: RA实际含义与功能
rules.explanation: 首页明确为Overview of Research Articles。研究论文报告原创研究，以证据、数据和事实推进学科知识；不要误解成Rhetorical Analysis或Reading Analysis。
rules.example: 原文短例：A research article (henceforth RA) is a written paper reporting the findings of an original study.

rules.title: 各部分功能
rules.explanation: Title定位主题；Abstract浓缩全篇；Introduction背景与问题；Literature Review相关工作；Methods如何研究；Results发现什么；Discussion意义、解释与局限；Conclusion收束；References列来源。
rules.example: 原创示例：Methods: Participants completed an online questionnaire.

rules.title: 结构与信息流
rules.explanation: IMRD是常见结构，不是所有学科唯一结构；教材还列出带Literature Review/Conclusion或合并Results-Discussion的变体。通常一般背景→具体研究→更广意义。
rules.example: 原创示例：General research problem → specific method and findings → broader implications.

rules.title: 标题分类
rules.explanation: standard如Methods；functional如Interpretation of the findings；content如Learning effort comparison。按功能识别，不只靠固定名称。
rules.example: 原文短例：General discussion（functional heading）

rules.title: 五类语言特征
rules.explanation: formality正式、complexity复杂性、objectivity客观性、precision精确性、stance taking立场表达。正式不等于故意用长词；名词化和名词短语压缩有助信息密度，但可读性优先。
rules.example: 原创示例：The data do not support this interpretation.
rules.before: The data don’t back up this stuff.
rules.after: The data do not support this interpretation.

rules.title: 语气与作者立场
rules.explanation: hedges（may/suggest/likely）限制确定性；boosters（clearly/definitely）加强；attitudinal markers评价重要/惊讶；self-mentions如we/I表明作者参与。按证据选用；教材也承认第一人称因学科而异，不是一律禁止。
rules.example: 原创示例：These findings suggest that repeated practice may improve recall.

rules.title: 客观与精确
rules.explanation: 明确对象、范围、单位、来源和限制。被动可突出过程，但过多会模糊行动者。避免空泛a lot of；只有来源给出数字时才改成数字。
rules.example: 原创示例：The survey included 42 students.（自拟练习数据）

exercises.prompt: RA在本资料中指什么？
exercises.answer: Research Article(s)，研究论文。
exercises.explanation: 由首页完整标题确认。

exercises.prompt: 研究对象招募、测量工具与步骤通常放哪一部分？
exercises.answer: Methods
exercises.explanation: 回答如何开展研究。

exercises.prompt: 解释发现的意义并讨论局限通常放哪部分？
exercises.answer: Discussion
exercises.explanation: Results主要报告发现，Discussion解释意义。

exercises.prompt: 判断：“所有研究论文必须有完全相同的IMRD四个标题”。
exercises.answer: 错误。结构与标题随学科、研究类型和期刊而变。
exercises.explanation: 教材列出多种变体。

exercises.prompt: 将口语表达改正式：We can’t figure out why it happened.
exercises.answer: We cannot determine why it happened.
exercises.explanation: 去缩写，换正式表达。

exercises.prompt: 判断语言特征：The findings may indicate an association.
exercises.answer: hedging（审慎限定）
exercises.explanation: may和indicate限制断言强度。

exercises.prompt: 分类标题：Interpretation of the findings
exercises.answer: functional heading
exercises.explanation: 按部分功能命名。

exercises.prompt: 分类标题：Effects of Online Discussion on Participation
exercises.answer: content heading
exercises.explanation: 以具体研究内容命名。

exercises.prompt: 把直接问句转为陈述：Why does this pattern occur?
exercises.answer: It remains unclear why this pattern occurs.
exercises.explanation: 用于学术问题陈述；保持从句陈述语序。

exercises.prompt: 判断：“学术论文永远不能使用we”。
exercises.answer: 错误。教材明确讨论self-mentions及学科差异。
exercises.explanation: 应根据学科惯例和表达需要选择。

rules.title: 评估来源
rules.explanation: 看作者资格、发布机构、日期、目的、证据、偏向和能否追溯。搜索排名高不等于可靠，网址后缀也不能单独保证可靠。
rules.example: 原创示例：A peer-reviewed article is usually more suitable than an anonymous promotional page for a technical claim.

rules.title: 引用两层结构
rules.explanation: 文内短引用让读者定位文末完整条目；文末列真实使用过的来源。引号只解决原词归属，不能取代来源信息。
rules.example: 原创练习：Lee (2020) argues that ... / ... (Lee, 2020).

rules.title: MLA与APA识别
rules.explanation: 教材MLA常用作者+页码、Works Cited；APA常用作者+年份、References，直接引语加页码。教材收录版本较旧，不当作最新规范；考试格式以教师指定版本为准。
rules.example: 原创练习：MLA: (Lee 12)；APA: (Lee, 2020, p. 12).

rules.title: 直接、间接与摘要都需来源
rules.explanation: 逐字引用要引号/按要求块引并标出处；改写与摘要仍引用。常识是否可不引取决于读者领域与任务，不要把专业结论都视作常识。
rules.example: 原创示例：用自己的句式概述作者结论，仍保留文内来源。

rules.title: 避免patchwriting
rules.explanation: 逐词换同义词和拼接原句不能替代理解。记录笔记时分开原句、作者观点和自己的评论；保存页码，写时离开原文，再回核。
rules.example: 原创示例：Notes: source claim / evidence / my interpretation / page.

rules.title: 无意剽窃与检测局限
rules.explanation: 附加教学文章强调分阶段练习、记录来源、改写反馈；相似度工具不能判断所有思想归属，也不能代替读懂和准确引用。
rules.example: 原创示例：A low similarity score does not prove that all sources have been acknowledged.

rules.title: 书目信息与特殊来源
rules.explanation: 保存作者、年份、题名、期刊/出版社、卷期页码与可用定位信息。二手转引应明确二手关系；未实际读取的原文不能冒充读过。
rules.example: 原创示例：As cited in ...（先说明实际读到的二手来源）

exercises.prompt: 选择更适合支撑学术主张的来源：署名有方法的研究报告，或无作者的广告页？
exercises.answer: 通常选择署名且方法透明的研究报告，同时核查质量与相关性。
exercises.explanation: 评估来源不能只看外观。

exercises.prompt: 识别格式：(Lee 12)
exercises.answer: 教材MLA式作者-页码文内引用。
exercises.explanation: 不是APA作者-年份。

exercises.prompt: 识别格式：(Lee, 2020)
exercises.answer: APA式作者-年份文内引用。
exercises.explanation: 练习占位例。

exercises.prompt: 判断：引用原词加了引号就不用写来源。
exercises.answer: 错误。引号与来源都需要。
exercises.explanation: 引号说明原词，引用说明谁说的、哪里可查。

exercises.prompt: 判断：引用句子写得与原文很像，但相似度低于某阈值就一定没问题。
exercises.answer: 错误。没有通用阈值能替代对原词和思想归属的检查。
exercises.explanation: 要看实际使用方式。

exercises.prompt: 把练习来源信息做APA短引：作者Chen，年份2021，直接引用第8页。
exercises.explanation: 仅为格式练习，不是真实文献。

exercises.prompt: 文内引用Brown，文末完全找不到Brown，应怎样修正？
exercises.answer: 核查实际来源后补齐对应条目，或纠正文内作者信息。
exercises.explanation: 不能凭空生成条目。

exercises.prompt: 抄下原句做笔记时应同时记录什么？
exercises.answer: 标明原句、作者、题名、年份、页码/定位信息，并与自己的笔记分开。
exercises.explanation: 防止笔记阶段丢失出处。

exercises.prompt: 只读到A转引B，能否把B写成自己直接读过的来源？
exercises.answer: 不能。应查看B原文或明确二手转引关系。
exercises.explanation: 来源透明。

exercises.prompt: 判断：这份教材里的MLA/APA排版细节就是2026年的最新要求。
exercises.answer: 不能这样认定。教材含较旧版本，应按考试指定版本复习。
exercises.explanation: 此训练总结课程材料，不冒充最新格式手册。

rules.title: 冠词与可数性
rules.explanation: 单数可数名词通常需要限定词；a/an用于非特指，the用于已确定对象。选a/an看发音。equipment、information通常不可数，不加复数-s。
rules.example: 原创示例：We used an instrument to collect the information.
rules.before: We bought an equipment.
rules.after: We bought a piece of equipment.

rules.title: 控制句长，突出主干
rules.explanation: 把主语谓语放在易读位置，过长列举可拆句或列表；前置背景过长会让读者找不到动作。清楚优先于句长。
rules.example: 原创示例：The team tested the method under three conditions. It then compared the results.

rules.title: Respectively要一一对应
rules.explanation: respectively用于前后两组顺序对应，只有一项或没有对应关系时不要添加。
rules.example: 原创示例：Groups A and B included 20 and 25 students, respectively.（练习数据）

rules.title: Study与paper
rules.explanation: study指研究工作；paper指呈现研究的文章。动词与对象对应：study investigates，paper presents/describes。避免重复this paper is organized as follows式套话。
rules.example: 原创示例：This study examines recall. This paper presents the results.

rules.title: 避免冗余和错误搭配
rules.explanation: 检查shown in Figure、research/equipment等用法；such as表示举例，列完整清单时可用冒号。删除obviously等无证据评价。
rules.example: 原创示例：The results are shown in Figure 2.
rules.before: The results are showed as Figure 2.
rules.after: The results are shown in Figure 2.

rules.title: 校对有优先级
rules.explanation: 先意义和结构，再句子、冠词、词形与格式。报告中的若干建议属作者编辑偏好，并非全部是不可违反的语法规则；如句首状语、短句和第一人称应按语境判断。
rules.example: 原创示例：先问主张是否清楚，再检查每个单数可数名词的限定词。

exercises.prompt: 改错：We used an equipment to measure the temperature.
exercises.answer: We used a piece of equipment to measure the temperature.
exercises.explanation: equipment不可数。

exercises.prompt: 改错：The results are showed as Figure 2.
exercises.answer: The results are shown in Figure 2.
exercises.explanation: 过去分词shown，介词in。

exercises.prompt: 选冠词：___ university；___ hour
exercises.answer: a university；an hour
exercises.explanation: 按首音而非字母。

exercises.prompt: 改错：Many informations were collected.
exercises.answer: Much information was collected.
exercises.explanation: information不可数，谓语单数。

exercises.prompt: 说明respectively的配对：Groups A and B contained 10 and 15 students, respectively.
exercises.answer: A组10人，B组15人。
exercises.explanation: 前后顺序一一对应。

exercises.prompt: 删去无用词：The only group contained 20 students, respectively.
exercises.answer: The only group contained 20 students.
exercises.explanation: 没有两组对应，无需respectively。

exercises.prompt: 区分：This paper presents the findings of the study.
exercises.answer: paper为文章，study为研究。
exercises.explanation: 两者不能机械互换。

exercises.prompt: 修正完整清单：The test has three parts such as listening, editing, and writing.
exercises.answer: The test has three parts: listening, editing, and writing.
exercises.explanation: 如果确为全部三项，用冒号；such as是举例。

exercises.prompt: 删除无依据评价：Obviously, our method is the best.
exercises.answer: The method performed well under the tested conditions.
exercises.explanation: 按证据限制范围；若没有测试信息，应进一步删改而非补编。

exercises.prompt: 判断：技术文章句子越长越显得专业。
exercises.answer: 错误。准确、清楚且逻辑完整比长度重要。
exercises.explanation: 过长句可拆分。
